_readme: Test corpus for a hand-written JSON parser (Day 07, Aug 12).
Load this file with json.load, then drive your own parser with it.
valid: your parser must accept these and produce the same value as json.loads.
invalid: your parser must raise on every one of these. Silent acceptance is the bug to hunt.
python_quirks: CPython's json module accepts these as documented extensions; RFC 8259 does not. Pick a side on purpose.
Every case here was checked against CPython 3.12's json module when this file was generated\.
